digest.component_or_area: test harness — nested pytest child isolation
propositions: Nested pytest child launched without private --basetemp joins user-global numbered temp root and synchronously scans/deletes unrelated retained trees during session shutdown, consuming the 90-second child timeout after test completes
Controlled filesystem A/B test shows private basetemp child completes in 0.882s while shared-root child takes 10.800s with 400,000 stale entries, proving cleanup cost scales with retained entries
SIGUSR1 capture at post-[100%] boundary shows main thread blocked in pytest.pathlib.cleanup_numbered_dir → rmtree, confirming root cause mechanism
Repair adds caller-owned tmp_path/nested-pytest via --basetemp argument, isolating session-finish cleanup without changing test selection, environment, timeout, or ambient-store assertions
